items.title: Allan Vaché interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 15, 2000
items.q: I mean Ray Brown, a monster.

ctx.x: Is there any kind of racial disharmony in the music these days that you’re aware of with the players?

I think there is a little bit but I really haven’t experienced any of it, okay. I have seen situations where — well I don’t want to criticize anyone, but I mean a situation like the Lincoln Center Jazz Ensemble that Wynton Marsalis has, and they’re trying to do more traditional jazz, and many of the guys are not that familiar with the traditional styles of music but they are given the job because they are not white players, they are black players. I think that’s unfortunate. But in all the traveling that I do and…
Yeah this festival seems to be —
